description: Finds trips for a group whose people leave from different towns to meet in one place on the same dates: each person's own door-to-door trip (the train, bus or car to their best airport, and the flight), one line per town, with the group's total, the longest journey and the dates that work for everyone. E.g. "Four of us want a week in Lisbon in May: two from New Haven, one each from Ithaca and Burlington." Put each town once in homes with how many people leave from it. For "where should we meet?" pass a region, countries or "anywhere" as destinations with anywhere true. For one home town, use find_trips. A month without a year means the next one coming. With no dates from the group this tool runs no search and returns the question to ask; once they name a time, or say any time suits them (flexible true), it searches. A month is enough to search: don't ask for exact dates. If a search finds nothing, say so and offer a wider window or single-town searches; never quote prices from other sources.

town.description: A home town, e.g. "Ithaca, NY" or "Hamden, US". Not an airport.
town.title: Town

anywhere.description: True to find the best places to meet in the countries or regions named.
anywhere.title: Anywhere

currency.description: ISO code (USD, GBP, EUR). Default: the first town's currency.
currency.title: Currency

depart_from.description: The window to leave in: first day. Leave out with depart_to for the next 3 months.
depart_from.title: Depart From

depart_to.description: The window to leave in: last day.
depart_to.title: Depart To

destinations.description: Where to meet: airport codes (LIS), cities, country codes (PT), a region, a continent (Europe) or "anywhere".
destinations.title: Destinations

flexible.description: True only when the group said any time suits them: the next 3 months are searched. Otherwise pass the dates they named.
flexible.title: Flexible

homes.description: Each town people leave from, with how many: [{"town": "New Haven, CT", "travellers": 2}, {"town": "Ithaca, NY"}]. Towns, not airports; the same town twice is one line.
homes.title: Homes

max_ground_hours.description: The most hours from the front door to the departure airport, one way. Default 8.5: farther airports are left out and named in the answer. Set it only when the user says how far they would travel to the airport, or to include the far ones the answer names.
max_ground_hours.title: Max Ground Hours

mode.description: How people get to the airport: public, train, bus, car or any. Leave out unless the user says: then any in the US, public elsewhere.
mode.title: Mode

nights_max.description: Trip length in nights: longest. Default 14.
nights_max.title: Nights Max

nights_min.description: Trip length in nights: shortest. Default 2.
nights_min.title: Nights Min

one_way.description: True if everyone flies one way only.
one_way.title: One Way

priority.description: Best for the group: budget (the lowest total), time (the fewest hours) or balanced. Default balanced.
priority.title: Priority

same_day.description: True if everyone must leave and return on the very same days; by default within a day.
same_day.title: Same Day

name: find_group_trips
title: Find group trips
